compared.query: transfer of the back-and-forth relation from a linear order to its labelled tree
compared.difference: reference/public-items.jsonl contains no row stating this transfer; a search for the label returns nothing.

the cards counted so far from this article cover the limit-plus-two orderings result, the replicated tuple tree rank, the minimal three universal orders, the translation lemma, the push-forward preservation proposition, the factoring criterion, the successor complexity corollary, the parameter-free comparison lemma, the rank-invariant universality lemma, the two-universality of the naturals with the rationals, the product rank shift and the shuffle sum lemma; this transfer lemma is a different statement and no retained range overlaps.
